create_minillm_trainer: create a MiniLLMTrainer instance for knowledge distillation between a student and teacher language model
train_student_model: train a student language model using knowledge distillation from a teacher model with MiniLLMTrainer
compute_kd_loss: compute the knowledge distillation loss using single-step decomposition with KL divergence between student and teacher log probabilities
compute_advantage: compute the reverse KL divergence advantage for distillation with optional gamma-weighted length normalization
run_distillation_training: run knowledge distillation training combining GRPO verifiable reward loss with teacher-student KL divergence loss
